fields.display_title: This paper aims to disentangle and study the regularization effect of batch normalization. By directly placing penalty on either the standardization of intermediate layers or the L2 norm of the output feature, the authors strive to match the performance boost from Batchnorm. Through experiments, the author came to the conclusion that it is the prevention of the explosive norm in the output feature that is the main contribution of batchnorm in network regularization.
